description: This source file defines a React hook 'useProgressiveExpand' and a utility function 'createProgressiveExpandController' for managing batch processing in a non-blocking, progressive manner. It is used for expanding tree nodes or similar operations incrementally, utilizing requestIdleCallback or setTimeout as fallbacks, with callbacks for progress, completion, and cancellation.
